title: Pack formats
description: Vendor packs, learned packs, rule packs and fix packs. Validated at load time; a rejected pack names the offending field. Formats documented in packs/CLAUDE.md.

version_spec.description: `*`, or comma-joined comparisons on the leading numeric release, e.g. `>=12.0,<16.0`.

detect_signature.description: Anchored regex. A bare string has weight 1.

match.description: Anchored regex against the statement text (indentation stripped).

scope.description: Template the parent block must match, e.g. `interface {name}`, or an anchored regex with named groups when the template is too loose. Omitted: top-level statements only.

value.description: Fixed value assigned when the line matches.

map.description: Captured text → canonical value. A capture not listed means the line is not understood.

empty.description: Collections only: what zero matches means.

defaults.description: Collections only: values for named groups that did not participate.

auto_key.description: Collections only: key missing from the line is assigned by position (10, 20, …) as defaulted.

keep.description: Scalars only: when several lines map this field, keep the smallest or largest value instead of the last. For list-valued settings such as accepted protocol versions.

fixture.description: Config snippet this mapping must match.

ignore.description: A line that carries no security setting. Removes it from the learning queue; writes nothing to the canonical model, so it never changes a verdict.

match.description: Anchored regex against the statement text (indentation stripped).

reason.description: Why the line carries no security setting. Required: an ignore with no stated reason is how a real setting gets dropped.

fixture.description: Config snippet this entry must ignore.

entry.description: One item of a mappings list: an ignore entry when `ignore` is present, otherwise a mapping.

constants.description: Canonical scalar field → value that holds for every device of this platform regardless of config, e.g. discovery.cdp_enabled: false on a platform without CDP. Emitted as defaulted with evidence.source platform_constant. A field may not be both a constant and a mapping target.

unresolved_inheritance.description: Regexes searched in every effective statement. A hit means the device inherits configuration from elsewhere in the file that this pack does not resolve, so absent fields stay unknown and no collection is taken as complete.

control.description: Benchmark control ID, cited not quoted. Null until a human verifies it.

for_each.description: Collection whose items the assertion is evaluated against, one by one.

assert.description: JMESPath; must evaluate to a boolean.

partial.description: How the rule may judge a list that is read but incomplete (complete: false). counterexample_sufficient (for_each rules): a visible item that fails is a FAIL; otherwise NOT_DETERMINED. lower_bound (rules like length(x) > 0): true on the visible items is a PASS, since more items cannot break it; otherwise NOT_DETERMINED. Omitted: NOT_DETERMINED.

fixtures.description: Canonical-model fragments (vendor-neutral): dotted path → value, collection path → list of items.

commands.description: A `{items}` line expands to item_commands once per failing item.

item_commands_for.description: Item name → commands used instead of item_commands for that item, e.g. Junos root, whose password lives at a different path from other users.

operator_input.description: Placeholders the operator must replace before pasting, e.g. <NEW_SECRET>.
